Definition: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
BiblicalUsage: 1) belly, womb, body; 1a) belly, abdomen; 1a1) as seat of hunger; 1a2) as seat of mental faculties; 1a3) of depth of Sheol (fig.); 1b) womb
